headline: France's default risk is now over twice its 2020 high, far above peers
subhead: 5-year sovereign credit default swap spread, basis points
note: A CDS spread is the annual cost, in basis points, of insuring government debt against default. Values are read off MacroMicro's published charts, so they are approximate (about ±2 bp) and sampled every 4 to 7 days. MacroMicro's France and Germany series begin in early 2020, so those lines start there; the US and UK start in 2018. Other vendors differ: Investing.com has France at 96 bp on Oct 22.
